_meta.note: Follow-up to the S274 price refresh: the OpenRouter catalogue had 132 ids with no DB model. Added the recent, non-roleplay ones as models (release_date = OpenRouter listing date, context = OpenRouter context_length) with first-party or cheapest-host prices, and priced existing models that OpenRouter lists under other ids. Skipped: roleplay/community finetunes (Sao10K, TheDrummer, Undi95, Gryphe, Mancer, Anthracite, Venice, AionLabs), OpenRouter routers and '~latest' aliases, 2023–2024 legacy ids (GPT-3.5/4-Turbo, o1-pro, Command R, Nova 1.0 Lite/Micro, WizardLM-2, Hermes 3), dated snapshots of already-priced models (qwen3.8-max-0902, qwen-plus, qwen3.5-plus-02-15), safety/guard classifiers, code-apply tools (Relace, Morph), Muse Spark 'contributor' variants, and ambiguous image ids (gpt-5-image, gpt-5.4-image-2).
